description: This file defines an Agent Service for executing AI-agent tasks, managing steps, tools, and interactions with a language model, including file reading/writing, timestamp retrieval, and calculations.

classes.name: AgentStep
classes.description: Represents a step in the agent's reasoning process, with type, content, and timestamp.

classes.name: AgentTool
classes.description: Defines a tool that the agent can invoke, with a name, description, and async action function.

classes.name: AgentError
classes.description: Enumerates possible errors during agent operation, providing error descriptions.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Core class managing agent execution, steps, tools, and communication with the language model, employing async operations and internal parsing logic.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Main method to run the agent with user input, handling the reasoning loop asynchronously.

methods.name: addStep
methods.description: Adds a reasoning step of specified type with content to the steps list.

methods.name: setupTools
methods.description: Initializes available tools for reading files, writing files, getting current time, and calculating expressions.

methods.name: executeAction
methods.description: Executes a specified action string by invoking the relevant tool with parsed arguments.

methods.name: parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string to extract the tool name and arguments, supporting multiple formats.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Processes argument string into a list of string arguments, accounting for quotes and commas.

methods.name: extractThought
methods.description: Extracts the <thought> content from model output.

methods.name: extractAction
methods.description: Extracts the <action> content from model output.

methods.name: extractFinalAnswer
methods.description: Extracts the <final_answer> content from model output.

methods.name: generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates the prompt instructing the language model on the format and available tools.
